body:
First of all: please write out TOTP (in the glossary). I had to google it too:-)

I see a bit of a contradiction to 2.17 because there we allow using email for sending a reset link. Also I do not agree completely to NIST regarding SMS. I know it has some severe security weaknesses. However I think ist is still better than email. May be you see me as a heretic now, but I beleive for most applications in the Internet it is fine yet. Anyway I am not aware of an authentication solution which is free of security issues. Personally. I would restrict the NIST verdict to applications with high protection requirements.
